lines: An entire army was marching... and one tiny ant saw it coming!
Hazrat Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, was marching with his army of men, jinn and birds.
They reached the valley of the ants... and one ant cried out:
O ants! Enter your homes, so Sulaiman and his soldiers do not crush you... without even realizing!
Sulaiman heard her... and he smiled.
Then he prayed: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor.
The most powerful king... answered the smallest voice with gratitude.
